title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover (edgecase)
author: Arielle Kim
description:
Summary: Hotfix to address an ordering edgecase in the SLO enforcer backoff logic that could cause regional thrashing and unnecessary load-shedding during failover. This surfaced after the regional-failover rollout when long tail retries in the primary region interleaved with failover candidate selection, causing the enforcer to mistakenly escalate backoff and shed traffic across regions.

Motivation and impact: The bug leads to oscillation between regions under certain timing windows (primary slow responses + staggered health checks). Consequences were intermittent customer errors and elevated 5xx rates for a subset of traffic. This change is targeted, low-risk, and intended to restore graceful degradation without changing global SLO targets or thresholds.

What I changed: Implement deterministic ordering in backoff queue processing, add a lightweight lease to ensure failover decision atomicy, and tighten the threshold smoothing window used by the enforcer so transient spikes don't trigger full-region backoff. Also added a focused integration test that simulates staggered retry and failover timings.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduce locally with region-failover harness
- [x] Add unit tests covering ordering and lease expiry
- [x] Add integration test that reproduces thrashing pattern
- [x] Run full CI + canary in staging
- [x] Post-merge monitoring dashboard updated and alert thresholds reviewed

Commits summary: 3 commits - 1) stabilize ordering in backoff queue; 2) introduce lightweight failover lease and GC; 3) tests and docs.

Files touched (high level): slo/enforcer/core.go (ordering loop), slo/enforcer/backoff_policy.go (smoothing/window), slo/enforcer/failover_lease.go (new), slo/enforcer/region_failover_test.go (new integration test), deploy/k8s/slo-enforcer-deployment.yaml (minor config bump for lease TTL), docs/slo-enforcer.md (notes on behavior).

Small illustrative diff snippet: "- processBackoff(item)
+ acquireLease(item.region)
+ processBackoffWithLease(item)
+ releaseLease(item.region)"

Review & discussion summary: Several reviewers validated the race condition. Ravi suggested reducing the lease TTL to 250ms to avoid long-standing locks; Lucia recommended adding a smoothing window to the SSE metrics to prevent alert noise; Marcus requested adding an integration test that simulates staggered retries with variable jitter. All suggestions were addressed in follow-up commits.

CI and validation: Full CI passed on final squash (unit + integration + e2e). One earlier CI run had a flaky e2e failure (timing) which passed after test stabilization. Post-merge canary in staging (region us-east-1 -> us-west-2) ran for 2 hours with no regression in 5xx or latency.

Rollback plan: revert the merge commit if post-merge monitoring shows >3% regression in 5xx over 30m, or re-enable previous behavior via feature flag (already instrumented).

Release notes: Fix ordering bug in SLO enforcer backoff that caused regional thrashing during failover. Improves stability and reduces unnecessary load-shedding.

Related: ENG-5124, SRE-231, SUP-8942
